distributions.provenance: arXiv e-print ancillary files anc/supplemental.txt (Tables II-V) and anc/supplemental.root (crossSection TH2D, crossSectionVector, covarianceMatrix TMatrixT), cross-checked against each other. Cross section values and full 67x67 covariance matrix taken from the higher-precision ROOT crossSectionVector/covarianceMatrix (agree with the rounded text-table Table II/IV/V values to <0.005e-38 cm^2/GeV^2). Bin scheme (which (E_avail,q3) cells exist per q3 slice) taken from Table III. Normalization: divided by flux and 3.17e30 nucleon targets in the tracker (H+C+O by weight 7.4%/88%/3.2%) -> tagged as per-nucleon CH target per project convention. Total error per bin = sqrt(diag(covariance)); verified sqrt(diag(cov))/err = 1 to machine precision by construction.
